title: Administrator / Legal Secretary Re-train Opportunity
description:

Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

We are ranked 60th in The Lawyer UK Top 200, out of more than 10,000 law firms nationwide, and after achieving a 24% year-on-year growth, Express Solicitors are the largest personal injury claimant firm in the UK.

Our commitment to outstanding client care is reflected in our Trustpilot rating of 4.7 (Excellent), placing us among the highest-rated firms in the sector.

We are currently looking for strong administrators ideally with a minimum of two years administration experience. Background in legal and medical advantageous

Responsibilities
- Working collaboratively within a pool of Legal Secretaries to support multiple Lawyers
- You will be working in one stream of work either Road Traffic Accidents, Employers' Liability or Occupiers & Public Liability.
- Preparing correspondence and legal documentation, including pleadings and court bundles
- Photocopying and scanning documents, with support from the Administration team where required
- Handling inbound and outbound telephone calls in a professional and courteous manner
- Scheduling appointments, arranging meetings, and liaising with Lawyers, clients, Counsel, and other stakeholders
- Providing support to fellow Legal Secretaries and the wider administration team as required
- Assisting with updates to the Proclaim case management system where appropriate

Person Specification:
- Demonstrable two years previous administration experience, background in legal and medical advantageous.
- Strong comprehension of English spelling, punctuation, and grammar.
- IT literate
- Exceptional customer service skills, including professional and friendly telephone manner.
- Acute attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise daily workload and experience of working in a fast-paced environment.
- Prior exposure to Proclaim case management system is desirable.
- Excellent word processing and audio typing skills
- Audio typing speed of 65+ words per minute
- Use of digital dictation, ideally Diktamen would be beneficial.

Salary & Hours
- A basic salary of up to £28,000
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; Legal Secretary, PA, Legal Typist, Typist, Legal PA, Secretary, Legal Administrator, Legal Office Support, Legal Assistant, Legal Business Support, Office Administrator, Business Support Admin Assistant may also be considered For This Role.

- Excellent progression opportunities

title: Costs Litigation/Paralegal
description:
About the Role

Costs Litigation Executive: Fixed Costs

Location: Manchester, Liverpool or Leeds

Hybrid - 1 day per week office attendance

Permanent

About HF

People. Not just lawyers

We're not your typical law firm - we're people with a passion for helping our clients and each other achieve the best possible outcomes. We are leading legal advisers to the insurance and commercial sectors across the UK & Ireland, known for our innovation, client focus, and long-lasting relationships. We do things differently, with a forward-thinking approach built around our clients' needs, supported by cutting-edge technology and a culture built around people from a wide range of backgrounds who are taking an equally wide range of routes to building their careers in law.

About the team

HF's Costs Department handles costs disputes across the full range of civil litigation, from fixed recoverable costs through to complex, high-value claims, and commercial litigation. The team acts for paying and receiving parties and combines technical costs expertise with pragmatic, commercially focused advice.

You can find out more about Costs Team here:Costs - HF

What our Team says;

"This is the most supportive work place I have worked at. There is always someone you can talk to, you never feel alone." - Litigation Executive - Costs Department.

"I've worked in costs for 20 years and I've never worked at a firm where the company policies make you feel as valued as a person. The compassionate leave I received when my grandparents passed away was generous and really allowed myself to grieve and return to work fully focused.

The costs department is a really good mix of people. There is smart knowledge and leadership in place and even though most people work remotely, there is still a sense of togetherness as a unit."- Associate Team Leader - Costs Department.

What you'll be doing?

Role Purpose

As a Costs Litigation Executive, you will manage a caseload of fixed recoverable costs and lower-value costs disputes, taking responsibility for the matter from initial review through negotiation and, where required, proceedings. The role is intended to provide genuine case ownership and a clear route to developing specialist expertise in costs litigation.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a caseload of fixed recoverable costs and lower-value costs matters in accordance with client requirements, procedural deadlines and internal standards.
- Review the underlying claim, procedural history and supporting material to identify the applicable costs regime and the issues in dispute.
- Prepare, consider and respond to Precedent U and associated schedules, evidence and submissions.
- Assess and challenge claims for fixed costs, disbursements, uplifts and other sums claimed, where appropriate.
- Conduct negotiations, make clear settlement recommendations and progress matters towards proportionate resolution.
- Draft applications, witness statements, written submissions and other procedural documents appropriate to the matter and level of experience.
- Manage fixed costs proceedings, including compliance with directions, evidence, hearing preparation and liaison with the court and other parties.
- Identify matters requiring technical or strategic escalation and seek supervision at the appropriate stage.
- Prepare focused briefs and instructions to counsel, including where an outcome is to be challenged or further advice is required.
- Provide clear, concise and timely advice to clients and substantive case handlers.
- Maintain accurate file records, financial and management information, compliance with service standards, and achieve agreed performance targets, including billing hours and fee income objectives.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues and provide assistance or cover where reasonably required.

What do I need?

Essential Skills and Experience
- Experience in costs, civil litigation, insurance claims or another relevant legal environment.
- Strong written and analytical skills, with close attention to detail.
- Ability to organise a caseload, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines.
- Confidence in questioning claims, evidence and assumptions in a constructive and professional way.
- Clear communication skills and the ability to give practical advice.
- Sound judgement, personal responsibility and willingness to escalate issues appropriately.
- A collaborative approach together with the ability to work independently.

Desirable but not essential:
- Experience of fixed recoverable costs or another area of legal costs.
- Familiarity with Precedent U, Part 45 or costs-only proceedings.
- Experience of legal drafting, negotiation, client reporting or case management systems.
- A relevant legal or costs qualification (Solicitor, CILEX or Costs Lawyer)

What's in it for you?

Apart from the competitive salary you'd expect, our package of benefits reflects our values of partnership, innovation, and being real people. We're committed to creating a dynamic workplace where everyone feels supported, empowered, and part of our success.

You'll enjoy:

25 days' annual leave (rising to 30 with service) + Holiday Buy Scheme

Life Insurance & Income Protection

Private Medical Insurance & Healthcare Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme & Digital GP services

Pension Scheme

Electric Car Scheme

Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave

Hybrid & Flexible Working Options

Discounted Gym Membership & Employee Discount Hub

Flu & Eyecare Vouchers - and more!

Sounds great? What next?

If HF sounds like a place where you could belong, we'd love to learn more about you!

Submit your CV here and we'll be in touch if we have any opportunities that match your experience and interests. If we don't have something right now, we'll keep your details on file and may reach out in the future as part of our talent pipeline.
